title: Use the 50/30/20 rule
body: Put 50% of income to needs, 30% to wants and 20% to savings.

title: Track small spending
body: Daily drinks and snacks add up. Log every one for a week.

title: Pay yourself first
body: Move money to savings on payday, before you spend.

title: Shop with a list
body: Write a list before shopping and buy only what is on it.

title: Wait 24 hours
body: For non-essential buys, wait a day. Many urges pass.

title: Set category limits
body: Give Food and Entertainment a monthly cap and check it weekly.

title: Build an emergency fund
body: Aim for 3 months of expenses saved for surprises.

title: Cook at home more
body: Cooking 3 extra meals a week can cut food spending a lot.
